title: U Mass - Cytokines Panel I - multiplex
author: Jason Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xvnfn5e
materials: Allow reagents and assay plate to come to room temperature. Gently remove wellcontents and wash plate 2x following the instructions listed in the Plate Washing section.
Add 25 μL of Detection Antibodies into each well. Allow the Detection Antibodies to warm to room temperature prior to addition.

steps.title: Initial Plate Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the plate wells to prepare for the assay.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 μL of Wash Buffer into each well of the plate.
Seal and mix on a plate shaker for 10 minutes at room temperature (20-25°C).
Decant Wash Buffer and remove residual amount by inverting the plate and tapping it onto absorbent towels several times.

steps.title: Add Standards, Controls, and Samples
steps.instruction: Load the standards, controls, and samples into the appropriate wells.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 μL of each Standard or Control solution into the appropriate wells (use Assay Buffer for 0 pg/mL standard/Background).
Add 25 μL of Assay Buffer to the sample wells.
Add 25 μL of Sample (diluted one part serum or plasma to one part Assay Buffer) into the appropriate wells.
Note: Use provided Serum Matrix for serum/plasma samples, or proper control culture medium for tissue culture/supernatants.

steps.title: Add Beads and Incubate
steps.instruction: Add magnetic beads to the wells and incubate overnight.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the Mixing Bottle and add 25 μL of mixed or premixed beads to each well, shaking the bottle intermittently to avoid settling.
Seal the plate with a plate sealer and wrap with foil.
Incubate with agitation on a plate shaker overnight (18-20 hours) at 4°C.

steps.title: Secondary Incubation
steps.instruction: Perform a second incubation at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Seal, cover with foil, and incubate with agitation on a plate shaker for 1 hour at room temperature (20-25°C).
Do not aspirate after this incubation.
Add 25 μL Streptavidin-Phycoerythrin to each well containing the 25 μL of Detection Antibodies.
Seal, cover with foil, and incubate with agitation on a plate shaker for 30 minutes at room temperature (20-25°C).

steps.title: Final Plate Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the plate twice using the magnetic bead washing procedure.

substeps.instruction: Gently remove well contents.
Let plate soak on magnet for 60 seconds to allow complete settling of magnetic beads.
Remove well contents by aspiration.
Wash plate with 200 μL/well of Wash Buffer.
Allow beads to soak for 60 seconds, then remove Wash Buffer by aspiration.
Repeat the soak and wash cycle a second time.
Note: If using Bio-Tek ELx405 plate washer, follow equipment settings.

steps.title: Resuspend Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare the plate for the Bioplex reader.

substeps.instruction: Add 150 μL of Sheath Fluid to all wells.
Resuspend the beads on a plate shaker for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Bioplex Analysis
steps.instruction: Run the plate and analyze the data.

substeps.instruction: Run plate on Bioplex 200 with parameters set for 125 µl and 75 beads per bead set.
Save and analyze Median Fluorescent Intensity (MFI) data using a 5-parameter logistic or spline curve-fitting method.
For diluted samples, multiply the calculated concentration by the dilution factor.
